candidates.description: This vector represents adjectives and adverbs of significance, importance, variation, and probability across multiple languages.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns and adverbial phrases related to manner, way, or aspect.
This vector represents golf course terrain features and natural landscaping elements.
This feature vector represents the concept of utilization, application, and the use of tools or methods.
This vector represents common Spanish infinitive action verbs.
This vector is related to common Spanish verb roots and high-frequency lemma prefixes.
These tokens represent Spanish modal and auxiliary verbs indicating ability, possibility, or necessity.
This vector represents the concept of placing, positioning, or setting an object in a specific location.
These tokens represent Spanish verb stems commonly subject to spelling variations or orthographic interference from English (such as confusing 'c' and 'f').
This feature vector represents adverbs and adverbial suffixes indicating manner, degree, or frequency across Romance languages.
